title: Register real-scale SOURCE_HISTORICAL windows so structure_tape can be screened at n>=5
hypothesis: Registering real multi-symbol/multi-regime historical bar+tape windows so both the champion v1 and structure_tape reach hold-out n >= promotion_min_sample_size (5) would let J-06's named-strategy sweep validate structure_tape on a meaningful hold-out instead of the current n=1 sample.
journey_sketch: Record additional real historical bar+tape windows (several symbols/regimes) as immutable checksummed datasets with a promotion-grade hold-out, re-run the structure_tape-vs-v1 sweep, and append the enlarged-split PnL to the ledger.
reject_reason: Structurally infeasible keyless. The only keyless dataset source is SOURCE_REFERENCE, a single committed PG SIP window (source_id PG_SIP_REFERENCE): train 2026-06-09 17:00:00-17:01:00Z (60s, 376 trades) and holdout 17:05:00-17:05:45Z (45s, 228 trades). With study_arm_cooldown_seconds=180s against 45-60s windows, each split arms <=1 trade, so n=1 per split (founding baseline AND J-06's live sweep both confirm holdout n=1 < promotion_min_sample_size=5). No keyless slicing reaches n>=5 on both splits; sim is deliberately not a dataset source; real diversity needs SOURCE_HISTORICAL (Alpaca credentials) = a credentialed operator action the proposer cannot and must not take. Same structural rejection as prior-era 'enlarge-holdout-to-promotion-grade-n'; no new datasets, champion unchanged (v1/default) -> dedup bars re-proposing a keyless dataset journey. Manufacturing an infeasible-keyless journey would fail the pipeline or force a dishonest green.
resume_condition: operator registers real-scale SOURCE_HISTORICAL datasets (hold-out n>=5) via credentials, or the champion changes, or a state/pnl-scan.json marks a survivor: true

title: Optional /levels UI view rendering canonical S/R levels + A/B/C classes
hypothesis: A read-only UI view over the canonical GET /research/levels would make era-4 structure data (levels + confluence classes) human-discoverable beyond the machine (REST+MCP) surface.
journey_sketch: Add a /levels page that reads GET /research/levels verbatim (no recomputation, one owner) with a [NEW]-flagged demo-narrator walkthrough.
reject_reason: Consciously deprioritized this cycle (recorded so a future wake does not rediscover it as novel). docs/goal.md Product Shape marks a levels view 'optional and out of the data-foundation scope'; general-purpose charting is a listed Non-Goal; the surface adds zero hold-out PnL delta (the decisive usefulness lens) and screens no candidate. Speculative and ranks below any data-backed survivor; promoting it would be manufacturing low-value work. On today's single keyless window it would render only the honest fixture levels.
resume_condition: a human elevates the levels view into scope, or a credentialed real-scale library makes the surface non-trivial

title: Sweep report labels n=0 abstention distinctly from genuine train-overfit
hypothesis: Splitting the reused 'overfit = train_positive and not survivor' flag into 'abstained (candidate_n=0)' vs 'genuinely overfit a spurious train edge' would remove the semantically-loose overfit=true label on an untraded candidate (iter-6 lesson B1 / audit OBSERVATION B1), keeping the survivor promotion gate byte-unchanged.
journey_sketch: When candidate_n=0 in the named-strategy sweep report, emit an explicit 'abstained' label instead of overfit=true; append no ledger row (no promotion); default/v1 byte-identical.
reject_reason: Both the iter-6 evaluator and the audit (OBSERVATION B1) classified this non-gating and NOT a defect: promotion hinges only on 'survivor' (correctly False) and the honest datum candidate_n=0 is already in the per-dataset breakdown. Zero hold-out PnL delta; changes no promotion decision; a cosmetic honesty-label refinement, not genuinely-useful enabling work. Below the dry-stop bar this cycle.
resume_condition: a future era generalizes the sweep further or surfaces 'overfit' in a human-read headline (per the iter-6 lesson 'Applies to')
